title: AvisConversationSwitchSchema
description: Defines interactive UI option prompts, branching logic, and menu switches for user selection.

switch_context_id.description: Unique UUID referencing this specific transactional choice point.

trigger_condition.description: The exact system state that caused the interactive menu to trigger.

display_prompt_text.description: The direct question or instruction rendered to the end-user interface.

interactive_options.description: The explicit choices presented to the user to guide the execution path.

target_intent_branch.description: The system keyword state this choice triggers if selected.

preloaded_payload_parameters.description: Optional parameters passed down to speed up execution when clicked.

allow_custom_user_override.description: If true, displays a text field alongside the choices for manual overrides.
